build_daily_activity_query: build a query to fetch paginated daily spend activity for users, teams, or organizations with date filters
build_daily_activity_aggregated: build an aggregated SQL GROUP BY query to fetch daily spend analytics collapsed across entities
build_breakdown_metrics: build per-model, per-provider, and per-api-key breakdown metrics from daily spend records
build_tag_metadata_totals: build deduplicated spend metrics from tag records, ignoring User-Agent prefixed tags
build_api_key_metadata: build a lookup of API key aliases and team IDs including deleted key fallback
